LESSON: CONTEMPORARY ISSUES • JIHAD • TERRORISM • EXTREMISM

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.6: Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How does terrorism and extremism affect the society? 2. How can terrorism and extremism be curbed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the rules of Jihad in Islam for correct interpretation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the causes of terrorism and extremism in the society,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. explain the effects of terrorism and extremism on the society,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. describes the measures to curb terrorism and extremism for peaceful co- existence,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. acknowledge Islamic teachings on Jihad as a guide to harmonious co- existence.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify the rules of Jihad in Islam for correct interpretation,

   Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the causes of terrorism and extremism in the society,

   Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. explain the effects of terrorism and extremism on the society,

   Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. describes the measures to curb terrorism and extremism for peaceful co- existence,

   Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. acknowledge Islamic teachings on Jihad as a guide to harmonious co- existence.

   Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

F. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify the rules of Jihad in Islam in groups and share in class,

2. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the correct interpretation of Jihad and make notes,

3. research online/available reference materials on the causes of terrorism and extremism and make notes,

4. research online/available reference materials on the effects of terrorism and present in class,

5. brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations,

6. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the measures to curb terrorism 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify the rules of Jihad in Islam in groups and share in class,
2. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the correct interpretation of Jihad and make notes,
3. research online/available reference materials on the causes of terrorism and extremism and make notes,
4. research online/available reference materials on the effects of terrorism and present in class,
5. brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations,
6. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the measures to curb terrorism 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: Global awareness skills are enhanced as learners research on the effects of terrorism and

extremism.

• Communication and collaboration: the skill of listening and speaking as learners brainstorm on the measures of

curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations.

• Critical thinking and problem-solving: the skill of open-mindedness and creativity is enhanced as learners

brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations.

Values:
• Peace is enhanced through discussion on the rules of Jihad in Islam in groups and share in class.

• Patriotism is enhanced as learners brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make

class presentations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Safety and security education: as learners use digital devices to search for the effects and measures of curbing

terrorism and extremism.

• Peace education: as learners brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class

presentations.

Link to other subjects:

• Social Studies as learners research on the effects of terrorism and extremism.
